server.title: SYMONE motorcycle transport
server.description: Search SYMONE motorcycle transport trips in France: dates, prices, free places and booking link.

serverInfo.name: symone-moto
serverInfo.instructions: Search motorcycle transport routes in France. Use search_routes to find available trips between French cities, then get_booking_url to hand the user the booking link (booking and payment only happen on symone.fr). All tools are read-only and public, no authentication required. Main route: Paris↔Marseille from 299€. Documentation questions: use the docs MCP server at https://symone.fr/docs/mcp.
